data.one_liner: Scan and refresh newly saved media files into the Android gallery
data.what_it_does: Allows your app to trigger a media scan on Android so that newly saved photos or videos appear immediately in the device gallery without needing a reboot.
use_when: You save photos or videos on Android and need them to show up in the gallery immediately
You are developing an Android-specific media management or capture application
avoid_when: You are not saving new media files that require a gallery refresh
strengths: Solves the specific problem of refreshing the Android media store
weaknesses: Very minimal functionality with no iOS implementation
data.setup_notes: Only works on Android; no special native configuration documented beyond standard plugin setup.
